models_evaluated: deep learning model with continual learning strategies

links.outcome: Model performance with continual learning versus plain sequential training across hospital and non-hospital cohorts
links.effect: CL outperformed sequential training control; cumulative AUROC 0.85 and AUPRC 0.65 on combined test set
links.quote: The CL method outperformed the control (sequential training without any strategies) method.

links.outcome: Performance degradation from distribution shift between hospital and non-hospital settings
links.effect: Distribution shift causes catastrophic forgetting; training order hospital to non-hospital gave AUROC 0.85 versus 0.79 for reverse order (7.6% improvement)
links.quote: Metabolic syndrome (MetS) is susceptible to misdiagnosis by DL models due to distribution shifts.

unlisted_practices: Continual learning training-order optimization to mitigate catastrophic forgetting

screen.reason: Empirical study testing continual learning strategies to prevent catastrophic forgetting and maintain performance under real-world multi-cohort distribution shifts across hospital and non-hospital settings.

primary.practice: continual learning adaptation to distribution shifts
